exposure: Infant obesity prevention program delivered via telephone calls
Infant obesity prevention program delivered via text messages
cohort: Participants were mothers with infants recruited from four Local Health Districts in New South Wales, Australia, enrolled in an early obesity prevention program.
finding: The infant obesity prevention program delivered via telephone achieved 100% participant satisfaction, while the SMS-delivered program achieved 85%, with participants appreciating personalized stage-based information and opportunities for communication with health professionals.
